label: SCX sched_ext schedulers (lavd default)
description: SCX extendable scheduler userspace: scx, scx-tools, scx-loader, scx-scheds with lavd as default. Enabled by default.
notes: Requires kernel with CONFIG_SCHED_CLASS_EXT=y (XanMod/Liquorix or 6.14+). Falls back to default scheduler if kernel lacks support.
